status.no_channel: No available channels to watch. Waiting for an ONLINE channel...
status.no_campaign: No active campaigns to mine drops for. Waiting for an active campaign...
status.catalog_unavailable: Campaign data is incomplete. Waiting for available rewards...
status.no_selection: No games selected for mining. Choose Mine in Campaigns to start.

telegram.help:
/status — current mining and confirmed progress
/pause — pause watching
/resume — resume watching
/mine Game — add a known game to automatic mining
/help — show commands

Saved priorities and manual selection still apply. Pause does not stop inventory or automatic claims.
telegram.login_required: Connect your Twitch account in Drops Miner first.
telegram.paused: Mining pause saved. Inventory and automatic claims continue.
telegram.selected: Selected {game} for automatic mining. Saved priorities, pause and manual channel selection still apply.
telegram.unknown_game: Game not found. Use its exact name from current campaigns or your saved games.
telegram.conflict: Settings changed while handling the command. Check /status and send it again if needed.
telegram.failed: The command could not be confirmed. Check /status before trying again.
telegram.menu_status: Show mining status and confirmed progress
telegram.menu_mine: Add a game to automatic mining: /mine Rust

auth.title: Dashboard password
auth.help: Protect this dashboard with one password. Changing it signs out other sessions. Disabling protection clears the password.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
auth.auth_changed: Authentication settings changed. Reload the page.
auth.forbidden: Request blocked. Open this app directly and try again.
auth.invalid_channel: Enter a Twitch channel name or a direct twitch.tv channel URL.
auth.invalid_manual_duration: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440, or leave the timer empty.
auth.twitch_login_required: Connect your Twitch account before selecting a channel.
auth.telegram_invalid: Enter a valid bot token and numeric chat ID.
auth.telegram_private_chat: Remote control requires your positive private chat ID. Group chats can receive alerts only.
auth.telegram_conflict: Settings changed on another device. Reopen Notifications to load the saved settings.
auth.telegram_storage: Telegram settings could not be read or saved. Check telegram.json in the data folder; the original file was preserved.
auth.telegram_disabled: Enable and save Telegram before sending a test.
auth.telegram_busy: A Telegram message is already being sent. Try again shortly.
auth.telegram_chat: Could not send to this chat. Check its ID and start a conversation with your bot.
auth.telegram_failed: Could not send the Telegram message. Delivery may be unknown; check your chat before retrying.

channels.name: Channels
channels.search_empty: No matches. You can still mine an exact channel name or URL.
channels.search_failed: Could not search Twitch. You can still enter an exact channel name or URL.
channels.not_found: That Twitch channel was not found.
channels.lookup_failed: Could not check that channel with Twitch. Try again.

settings.drop_name_blacklist_help: Enter one keyword per line. Matching is a case-insensitive literal substring. Matching drops and their dependent branches are ignored; prerequisite-only branches are skipped while shared prerequisites remain mineable.
settings.multiple_games_found: Choose a game from the results.
settings.manual_game_warning: Add "{game}" manually? Use the exact Twitch category name.

inventory.skipped_branch_reason: Skipped because no mineable reward depends on this drop.

redesign.copy_code_failed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it manually, or open the dashboard over HTTPS.
redesign.refresh_failed_detail: Could not refresh campaign data. Your previous results are kept. Try again.
redesign.connect_help: Authorize your Twitch account to load campaigns.
redesign.waiting_help: Waiting for an eligible reward and live channel. The miner checks automatically.
redesign.campaigns_unavailable: Campaign data is incomplete or the public catalog is unavailable or stale. Previously known rewards are kept, and manual channels can still be watched.
redesign.campaign_empty_help: Check the filters and Twitch account status, or refresh the inventory.
redesign.history_campaign_missing: No recorded claims for this campaign.
redesign.history_drop_missing: No recorded claim for this reward.
redesign.history_error: Could not load history. Try again.
redesign.login_description: Enter your dashboard password to continue.
redesign.disconnected_help: Connection lost. Showing the last known state; controls will resume after synchronization.
redesign.server_unavailable: The dashboard server is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.
redesign.settings_conflict: Settings changed on another device. Review your edits, then retry to apply them.
redesign.proxy_help: Optional HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Leave empty for a direct connection.
redesign.save_first: Wait for your changes to finish saving before continuing.
redesign.disable_help: Anyone who can reach this dashboard will be able to use it. Your password and existing sessions will be cleared.
redesign.authorization_pending: The miner will display an authorization code when Twitch login is required. If it remains unavailable, check Activity for the reported error.
redesign.cache_help: Clear cached campaigns, channels, derived miner state, and local claim history, then refresh from Twitch. Cleared claims will not be imported again. Login, settings, and completed campaign records are kept. This cannot be undone.
redesign.shutdown_help: This stops the miner and dashboard. Your process manager or Docker restart policy determines whether it restarts automatically.
redesign.help_link_accounts: Link the appropriate game account on
redesign.settings_invalid: Enter a valid proxy URL and a whole refresh interval from 1 to 1440 minutes.
redesign.settings_save_failed: Changes could not be saved. Your edits are kept here.
redesign.reorder_help: Drag a game by its handle. With the handle focused, use the up and down arrow keys to reorder. Escape cancels dragging.
redesign.priority_manual_help: Selected games are mined first, in your saved order. Drag games to change their priority.
redesign.priority_short_events_help: Selected games are mined first. Active drops available for 24 hours or less take priority, earliest deadline first. Your saved drag order breaks ties.
redesign.priority_ending_soonest_help: Selected games are mined first, with the nearest reward deadlines taking priority. Your saved drag order breaks ties.
redesign.auto_claim_drops_help: When off, claim earned drops yourself in your Twitch inventory before they expire. Some rewards require earlier drops to be claimed. Turning this back on also claims outstanding drops. A claim already in progress may still finish.
redesign.auto_mine_types_help: Also mine matching rewards from other games, soonest-ending campaigns first, including required prerequisite drops. Allowed reward types and ignored names still apply.
redesign.mine_game_help: Select this game for mining across its eligible campaigns.
redesign.select_games_help: Choose Mine on a campaign to select its game.
redesign.update_check_failed: Could not check for updates. Try again.
redesign.game_search_failed: Twitch search is unavailable. You can still add a name.
redesign.client_outdated: The dashboard has changed. Reload to reconnect. Your edits are still here.
redesign.settings_restored: Your unsaved edits were restored. Review them, then retry to save.
redesign.settings_reload_failed: Your browser could not keep your edits for reload. Copy them before refreshing.
redesign.campaign_missing_help: This campaign is not in the current inventory or recorded history.
redesign.drop_missing: This reward is no longer in the campaign.
redesign.link_unknown: Account linking has not been confirmed.
redesign.mining_state_waiting_channel: Waiting for an eligible live channel
redesign.mining_state_manual_offline: Waiting for your channel to go live
redesign.telegram_enabled: Notify me when a reward is claimed
redesign.telegram_control_help: Use /status, /pause, /resume and /mine Game in your private bot chat. Requires a dedicated bot and a running miner. Old commands are discarded when controls start.
redesign.telegram_help: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then open your new bot and send /start. Enter its token and your numeric chat ID. Save, then send a test. Leave the token blank to keep the saved one. Setup instructions are in the README.

backend.session_storage: The saved Twitch session could not be removed. Check the data directory permissions.
backend.worker_failed: The mining task stopped unexpectedly. Shutting down safely.
backend.telegram_delivery_failed: Telegram message could not be sent. Mining continues.
backend.telegram_controls_failed: Telegram commands are unavailable. Check the token and connection. Mining continues; polling will retry.
backend.telegram_controls_conflict: Telegram commands conflict with another bot receiver or webhook. Use a dedicated bot for this miner. Mining continues.

desktop.notifications: Notify me when a reward is claimed
desktop.keep_awake_failed: Could not prevent automatic sleep. Your system's power settings still apply.
desktop.tray_unavailable: The system tray is unavailable. Closing the window will quit the app.

desktop.start_help: The app could not open its data or logs. Check folder permissions and close any other miner using this data, then restart.
